_comment: Value bands → autonomy level for Project Engine tier-gated auto-tasking (§9.5 Contract B). This file is the value axis ONLY. Ceiling/idempotency/kill-switch/audit machinery lives in @governed (nce/autonomy/governor.py). Do NOT duplicate governance logic here.

tiers.label: Autonomous
tiers.description: Fully autonomous — BOM sync self-executes without human confirm.

tiers.label: Actor/Confirm
tiers.description: Actor may execute with single human confirmation step.

tiers.label: Advisor + PL Review
tiers.description: Advisory output only — requires Project Lead review before action.

tiers.label: Advisor Only
tiers.description: Advisor-only — no autonomous or single-confirm action permitted at this value.
